ResearchProjectDef.label: flak armor
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft improved metal armor to protect from gunshots and explosions. This weighty armor slows movement slightly.

ResearchProjectDef.label: scout flak armor
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft lightened metal armor to increase movement but has less protection.

ResearchProjectDef.label: heavy flak armor
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft reinforced metal armor to protect from heavy gun fire and explosions. This armor is heavy and slows movement.

ResearchProjectDef.label: officer flak armor
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft prestige metal armor to enhance psycasting abilities while maintaining protection. Note that these also require gold.

ResearchProjectDef.label: modified flak helmets
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft modified helmets which offer increased protection, integrated gasmasks, and insulation against the elements.

ResearchProjectDef.label: frontier uniforms
ResearchProjectDef.description: Tailor uniforms which provide insulation from the elements and slight protection.

ResearchProjectDef.label: officer uniforms
ResearchProjectDef.description: Tailor uniforms which provide insulation, protection, and social status.

ResearchProjectDef.label: infantry kit
ResearchProjectDef.description: Tailor bandoleers for usage by infantry.

ResearchProjectDef.label: shocktrooper kit
ResearchProjectDef.description: Tailor bandoleers for usage by shocktroopers.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Scout kit
ResearchProjectDef.description: Tailor bandoleers for usage by scouts.

ResearchProjectDef.label: support kit
ResearchProjectDef.description: Tailor bandoleers for usage by support forces.

ResearchProjectDef.label: streamlined production
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft streamlined guns which are cheaper to produce but are inferior quality.

ResearchProjectDef.label: specialized accelerant
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft specialized guns which use a volatile accelerant to create a higher rate of fire.

ResearchProjectDef.label: power weapons
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft specialized melee weapons which use improvised generators to create electric shocks on hit.
